name: @nova-audio-agent/desktop
description: Local-first ambient voice agent desktop client

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test && node scripts/source-startup-smoke.mjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --config.mac.identity=- --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.hardenedRuntime=false --mac dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac:candidate: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --config.mac.identity=- --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.hardenedRuntime=false --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:mac:release: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --config.productName=NovaAudioAgentDesktop --linux AppImage deb --publish never
